correctness.rationale: The proof gives exact equations for both singularity constraints, evaluates the resulting quadratic-character sums for all invertible nonscalar similarity types, and handles scalars and ranks zero and one separately. The unique smallest intersection \(q^2-1\) occurs exactly for matrices with nonzero trace and irreducible characteristic polynomial. The packaged checker exhausts all matrices for \(q=3,5\) and all nonscalar similarity types plus scalars for \(q=7,11\).
